counterexample.note: Tick 70 is a multiple of the tick spacing, so the repair returns it without checking its bitmap bit, although it is not initialized. The liquidity total still matches only because tick 70 has no liquidity.

summary: Keeps the start tick as the first tick whenever it is a multiple of the tick spacing, without checking its bitmap bit. It also adds a bit-255 branch that can never run, because the rounded-down tick is never above the start.
